subject: Please confirm your bank details
body:
Dear Pennine Print & Pack Ltd,

We have received your invoice TV3110 and noticed that the bank account number on the invoice does not match the one on file. Could you please confirm your bank details by phone on the number on file: +44 118 496 0017.

Thank you.
